prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 30 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1317; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment kept growing well beyond what this injury usually needs, with more visits and new services added month after month.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed head-on collision with complaints of neck and low back pain and stiffness. Initial examination revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced cervical range of motion, findings consistent with the mechanism of injury described. Neurological screening, including reflexes and sensation in the upper and lower extremities, was unremarkable. No prior injury to the cervical or lumbar region is documented in the available history. Conservative care was initiated, consisting of spinal mobilization, therapeutic exercise, and home stretching instruction. Over the course of approximately thirty visits, treatment frequency and the range of services expanded, with additional modalities added over time, although the presenting injury would typically be expected to resolve on a shorter course. Billing records reviewed for this summary show no duplicate or repeated charges. Current status is improving, with ongoing pain reported at a lower intensity. Recommendation is continued home exercise and reassessment at the next scheduled visit.
